slides.heading: MCP, in one sentence.
slides.pull: MCP is USB-C for AI — one open standard that lets any AI assistant talk to any business tool.

cards.title: Open Standard
cards.body: Donated to the Linux Foundation (Dec 2025). Not locked to any one vendor.

cards.title: Any AI, Any Tool
cards.body: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot — all speak MCP. So do Asana, Figma, Slack, Jira.

cards.title: Already In Your Box
cards.body: Marketer MCP ships with SitecoreAI. No extra license, no infra to run.

slides.hint: 3:00 – 4:30 · The USB-C analogy lands with every audience — keep it short, move on.

slides.heading: From prompt to Sitecore action — in 6 steps.

cards.title: Security Layer
cards.body: OAuth 2.0 via Sitecore Identity · short-lived tokens · tenant isolation · every tool call authenticated.

cards.title: Permission Inheritance
cards.body: The AI can't do anything you can't do. Your Sitecore role is the ceiling.

cards.title: Full Audit Trail
cards.body: Every action logged with job ID. Reviewable. Reversible.

cards.title: Your Data Stays Yours
cards.body: Prompts and content never train the model. Zero data leakage by design.

slides.hint: 4:30 – 6:00 · This slide kills the biggest enterprise objection: Is it safe?

slides.heading: 30+ tools. Every major marketer workflow.
slides.hint: 6:00 – 7:00 · Skim fast. Don't memorize — just know the surface area is huge.

slides.heading: What's the catch? (There's always a catch.)

cards.title: ⚠ Early days
cards.body: Marketer MCP is only reliable for documented use cases. Off-script prompts can produce unexpected output.

cards.title: ⚠ Always review
cards.body: Treat AI-generated pages like any draft — review before publish. Existing approval workflows still apply.

cards.title: ⚠ Needs Stream enabled
cards.body: Your Cloud Portal admin must turn on Sitecore Stream. Takes 5 minutes, but check before you evangelize.

cards.title: ✓ Rollback is a click
cards.body: Every AI change is versioned. Undo is native. You're never stuck with a hallucination.

slides.hint: 26:00 – 27:30 · This slide BUILDS trust. Honesty about limits = credibility for the rest of the claims.
